title: Mara and the Uniform
author: Dominic Sterling
blurb: Cyrus Pemberton, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
